description: Payment Return: Debtor identification should follow standard Party rules (Name, Address, or ID).
errorMessage: Debtor party identification rules not met in pacs.004.
fix: Ensure <Dbtr> has <Nm> or standard identification (OrgId/PrvtId) when present.

description: Payment Return reason code (RtrRsnInf.Rsn.Cd) must be a valid ExternalReturnReason1Code.
errorMessage: Return reason code (RtrRsnInf/Rsn/Cd) is not a valid ExternalReturnReason1Code.
fix: Set <Cd> inside <RtrRsnInf><Rsn> to a valid code, e.g. FOCR (Following Cancellation Request), AC01 (Incorrect Account Number), or CUST (Requested by Customer).

description: Returned interbank settlement amount must not exceed the original interbank settlement amount.
errorMessage: RtrdIntrBkSttlmAmt exceeds the original IntrBkSttlmAmt — a return cannot exceed the original payment.
fix: Set <RtrdIntrBkSttlmAmt> ≤ <OrgnlIntrBkSttlmAmt>, deducting any return charges if applicable.

description: Returned amount must be greater than zero.
errorMessage: Returned amount (RtrdAmt) must be greater than zero.
fix: Set <RtrdAmt Ccy="EUR">1000.00</RtrdAmt> to a positive amount greater than 0.

description: CBPR+: Return reason must use <Cd> not <Prtry>.
errorMessage: Return reason must use the standard <Cd> code, not <Prtry>, per CBPR+.

description: OrgnlUETR is mandatory in pacs.004 TxInf to identify which payment is being returned.
errorMessage: OrgnlUETR is mandatory in pacs.004 TxInf to identify the original transaction.
fix: Add <OrgnlUETR>4a1a0945-5772-409a-83ba-240e666e0267</OrgnlUETR> with the UUID v4 from the original transaction.

name: PACS004_CreDtTm_Date_Format_Invalid
description: GrpHdr/CreDtTm contains an invalid ISO 8601 datetime. Common errors: 'Z' suffix, milliseconds (.123), missing timezone offset.
errorMessage: GrpHdr/CreDtTm has an invalid datetime format. Must be YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS+HH:MM (no Z, no milliseconds).
fix: Replace with a valid ISO 8601 datetime. Format: YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS+00:00 (e.g. 2026-06-09T10:00:00+00:00). Never use 'Z' suffix or milliseconds.

name: PACS004_AppHdr_CreDt_Format_Invalid
description: AppHdr/CreDt contains an invalid datetime. Must be YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS+HH:MM. Z suffix and milliseconds are forbidden under CBPR+.
errorMessage: AppHdr/CreDt has an invalid datetime format. Must be YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS+HH:MM (no Z, no milliseconds).
fix: Replace with a valid ISO 8601 datetime with timezone. Example: 2026-06-09T10:00:00+00:00.

name: PACS004_Character_Set_Usage
description: All text values must comply with the CBPR+ permitted character set. Standard fields: A-Z a-z 0-9 space /\-?:().,'+. Extended fields (Nm, Adr, RmtInf): additionally !#$&%*=^_{{|}}~";<>@[\]. Use < for < and > for >.
expression: all(re.match(r'^[A-Za-z0-9 /\-?:().,\'+]*$', str(v)) for k, v in DATA.items() if isinstance(v, str) and not k.endswith('@Ccy') and not k.endswith('@Tp') and not re.search(r'(IBAN|BIC|LEI|UETR|MsgId|BizMsgIdr|CreDtTm|IntrBkSttlmDt|Nm|AdrLine|StrtNm|TwnNm|Ustrd|AddtlInf)', k))
errorMessage: Character set used does not comply with CBPR+ UHB specifications. Only A-Z a-z 0-9 space and /\-?:().,\' are permitted in standard fields. Nm/Adr/RmtInf fields allow extended charset including !#$&%*=^_{{|}}~";<>@[\].
fix: Remove characters outside the CBPR+ permitted set. For Nm/Adr/RmtInf fields use the extended charset. Replace < with < and > with >.
